subject: Request: cryptographic custody & rotation artifacts for SIG review
messages:
From: Jane Dodson <jane.dodson@acme.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: request for key custody, rotation timeline, and HSM access exports

Hi Dylan,

Per our SIG intake, Acme's security team needs a narrow set of artifacts to close the cryptography section:

- Export of HSM access logs for the past 6 months (UTC timestamps) with role mappings.
- KEK/DEK lineage (who wrapped/unwrap operations), including key IDs and wrap/unwrap timestamps.
- KDF/derivation diagrams for tenant BYOK flows (how KEKs/DEKs are derived and stored).
- Proof-of-rotation entries (e.g., rotation events and resulting active key IDs).
- A signed BYOK handoff receipt for our tenant (DocuSign acceptable).

We understand sensitive material will need to be redacted; please indicate redaction approach and provide a hashed identifier we can match to audit records. Targeting SIG submission by EOD 2029-03-20. Can you confirm availability and an ETA for each artifact?

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Dodson
Principal Information Security, Acme Corp
security@acme.com

[Attachment: SIG_evidence_checklist_v1.docx (DOCX, 18KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dodson <jane.dodson@acme.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: request for key custody, rotation timeline, and HSM access exports

Jane — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested; below is a scoped ETA and notes on format/redaction: 

1) HSM access logs (6 months) — ETA: 2029-03-19 17:00 UTC. Will be CSV export with activity_type, principal_role, key_id (redacted to SHA256 hash), timestamp_utc. Highly sensitive fields (operator usernames) will be redacted; role mappings provided separately.

2) KEK/DEK lineage (wrap/unwrap) — ETA: 2029-03-19 17:00 UTC. We will include key IDs (hashed), operation (wrap/unwrap), and operation_timestamp. 

3) KDF/derivation diagrams for BYOK — ETA: 2029-03-19 12:00 UTC. PDF sequence diagram showing salt derivation, HKDF parameters, and storage locations.

4) Proof-of-rotation entries — ETA: 2029-03-19 17:00 UTC. Rotation audit entries exported from our KMS with rotation_event_id, old_key_hash, new_key_hash, and signed audit timestamp.

5) BYOK handoff receipt — ETA: 2029-03-20 09:00 UTC. We can generate a DocuSign receipt with a per-tenant agreement; will provide a URL.

We're going to pull the exports and prepare a redaction summary. Looping in Karthik (crypto ops) and Irene (compliance) to assemble artifacts. If you need raw logs under NDA, let us know and we'll coordinate a secure transfer.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security
Redwood Inference
[attachment: request_acknowledgement.txt (TXT, 1KB)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG: request for key custody, rotation timeline, and HSM access exports

Team — forwarding Acme's ask (see below). Please gather the following artifacts and redaction guidance. I'll be primary contact for delivery.

Action items (priority order):
- HSM access export: last 6 months, include principal_role, action, key_id (hash), timestamp_utc. Redact operator identifiers; include role mapping CSV.
- KEK/DEK lineage: include wrap/unwrap events, key_id hashes, and operation timestamps; mark which keys are on HSM vs. KMS-only.
- KDF diagram: produce HKDF/HMAC param doc + sequence diagram for tenant BYOK and envelope encryption.
- Rotation proofset: signed audit entries (we sign with internal signing key), include rotation_event_id mapping.
- BYOK handoff receipt: compile signed receipt and DocuSign link for the tenant.

Notes on scope: Acme is asking for items we normally bundle for SIG/SOC2 reviews — no raw private keys will be provided. For export formats, CSV and PDF are fine. Please place artifacts in the secure drive path and flag anything that requires additional approvals.

Cc: Acme for visibility (will collapse in outgoing).

Thanks — Dylan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, Jane Dodson <jane.dodson@acme.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2029 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG: request for key custody, rotation timeline, and HSM access exports

Dylan / Jane — attaching the assembled artifacts for Acme's review. We redacted operator usernames and replaced key IDs with SHA256(key_id) prefixed by key type (KEK/DEK). Summaries:

- hsm_access_export_redacted.csv (CSV, 36KB): columns = timestamp_utc, action, principal_role, key_hash, status.  Excerpt included below.
- kek_rotation_schedule_6mo.csv (CSV, 8KB): planned and actual rotation events with rotation_event_id and new_key_hash.
- kdf_sequence_diagram_v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB): HKDF params, salt derivation, tenant envelope flow, and where derived keys are persisted (HSM-sealed KEK vs. encrypted DEK in object store).
- byok_handoff_receipt_signed.txt (TXT, 2KB): human-readable receipt signed by our compliance authority (embedded SHA256 receipt hash).
- redwood_kek_lineage_summary.zip (ZIP, 120KB): combined JSONL of lineage events (redacted) and a readme describing redaction.

We observed one out-of-window rotation event on 2028-10-05 that was remediated; details are in the lineage summary. If Acme needs unredacted operator IDs under NDA, we'll provision a separate export through our secure file transfer.

Delivery links:
- Secure Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/acme/sig-evidence-2029-03-19 (access: Acme-SIG-Group)
- DocuSign (BYOK receipt): https://docusign.net/REDACTED/acme-byok-2029-03-19

Please confirm receipt and whether the hash mapping approach works for the SIG reviewer. Happy to run through the diagrams with your team.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Crypto Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
